set.body:
Defect: The one place revision 1 was TOO TIMID: keeping the Python xlsx reader alive as informal 'reference semantics' beside a Scala reader recreates D10 -- two implementations of one rule -- on purpose. tools/corpus/ also holds five Film-Festival-specific replay scripts that C1 left untouched.

Do: DECIDE in the ADR: either the Scala reader is THE reader and Python consumes descriptors/TSV, or the two are bound by a differential test on a synthetic workbook and Python is retired when that test is green.

Exit: The decision is recorded, with the fate of the five filmfest replay scripts named.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S4 'open decisions'
set.title: intake P6 DECISION: retire tools/corpus/xlsx_rows.py or bind it by differential test
